## Check the mechanism and the scope of the evidence

In NCM, which part of generation is sequential, and which part can be parallelized? What would be an excessive conclusion from a strong Sudoku result?

<details>
<summary>Show the reasoning</summary>

Code levels are generated sequentially, from coarse to fine; positions within one level can be predicted in parallel. A Sudoku result documents performance in a specific domain and protocol. It does not establish general reasoning ability, interpretability of latent codes, or universal superiority over autoregressive and diffusion models.

</details>
